choices.name: choiceTemplate_IndividualOutrightGifts
choices.choiceText: Individual Outright Gifts — one-time cash, check, or card gifts. No pledge, no schedule; a single completed transaction per row.

choices.name: choiceTemplate_SinglePaymentPledges
choices.choiceText: Single Payment Pledges — a pledge commitment with only one expected payment. Creates the parent Gift Commitment and its first (and only) Gift Transaction in a single row. Includes match-eligibility and restriction fields.

choices.name: choiceTemplate_PledgePayments
choices.choiceText: Pledge Payments — individual payments applied against pledges that already exist. Each row picks a commitment; designations cascade from the commitment's defaults.

choices.name: choiceTemplate_EventRegistrations
choices.choiceText: Event Registrations — ticket / registration payments where part or all of the amount is fee-for-service. Includes a Fair Market Value column so the deductible portion can be split from the goods-received portion.

choices.name: choiceTemplate_Default
choices.choiceText: Undefined Batch — uses the default Salesforce Standard Template, a clean baseline that mirrors what Salesforce ships out of the box with no FQS columns added. Use it as a starting point when you want to build your own template from scratch.

Flow.description: Home-page launcher that creates a new GiftBatch from three inputs: template (radio with fuller descriptions than the raw picklist labels), estimated value, and estimated gift count. Auto-number Name field is populated by the platform on insert. Success screen mirrors FQS_Gift_Entry_Single_Launcher_Account.Success_GiftCreated voice — green-check header, one-line summary, /lightning/r/GiftBatch/{Id}/view link. Embedded on FQS_Home_Page_Default sidebar in the "Create Gift Batch" accordion section, directly under Guided Gift Entry.
Flow.label: FQS Create Gift Batch

recordCreates.description: Inserts the GiftBatch with the three user-supplied fields. Name is auto-number so the platform fills it in. storeOutputAutomatically=true so {!Create_GiftBatch} returns the new record Id used by Screen_Success's link.
recordCreates.name: Create_GiftBatch
recordCreates.label: Create Gift Batch

screens.description: Single input screen. Radio picker with the 5 shipped Screen Template values, each surfaced with a fuller sentence-length description rather than the terse Salesforce label. Estimated gift count and expected total value collect the reconciliation targets used by the Gift Batch record page's dry-run and process-batch checks.
screens.name: Screen_Batch_Details
screens.label: Create a Gift Batch

fields.name: DisplayText_Intro
fields.fieldText:
Start a new Gift Batch.

Pick the template that matches the shape of gifts you're about to enter, then estimate the count and total value so the batch can reconcile against your source (deposit slip, event roster, mail run) during dry-run and processing.

fields.name: pkScreenTemplate
fields.helpText: The template controls which columns appear on every row of the grid. You can't change the template after the batch is created — if you pick the wrong one, delete the batch and start again.

fields.name: numExpectedValue
fields.helpText: The total dollar value you expect this batch to add up to — from your deposit slip, event ticket roster, or the sum of the checks in front of you. Dry-run compares this against the sum of entered gifts and flags a mismatch.

fields.name: numEstimatedCount
fields.helpText: The number of gift entries you expect to add to this batch. Dry-run compares this against the actual row count and flags a mismatch.

screens.description: Terminal confirmation screen. Voice / spacing mirror FQS_Gift_Entry_Single_Launcher_Account.Success_GiftCreated: green-check header, one-line summary, record-open link. {!Create_GiftBatch} resolves to the just-inserted record Id (storeOutputAutomatically).
screens.name: Screen_Success
screens.label: Success - Gift Batch Created

fields.name: SuccessHeader
fields.fieldText: ✓ Gift Batch created.

fields.name: SuccessSummary
fields.fieldText: Open the batch to set defaults, then start entering gifts. Dry-run and process from the batch record page when you're ready.

fields.name: SuccessLink
fields.fieldText: Open the new Gift Batch →

fields.name: SuccessFooter
fields.fieldText: Click Finish to close, or open the record above to keep working.
